{What tactical trick can Black use to gain a good position against White's
early b2-b4 advance?} 6... Nxb4 {[%wrong There's a stronger option. Try again
and look for a good capture.] [%hint Sacrifice a knight in order to win it
back by using the pin on the long diagonal.]} (6... cxb4 $2 7. axb4 {If Black
wins a pawn now with Nxb4, White will develop a strong attack that we will
examine more in the next challenge. Try again and look for a better forcing
option.}) (6... d6 $2 7. bxc5 {After Black recaptures, White has a slight
advantage thanks to the extra center-pawn. Try again and look for a strong
capture.}) (6... Bxc3 $2 7. dxc3 {White gains the bishop pair and more active
pieces. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 7. axb4 {Great start! How
should you win back the lost material?} cxb4 {[%wrong There's a stronger move.
Try again and look for a good capture.] [%hint Recapture and attack the pinned
white knight.]} (7... Bxc3 $2 8. dxc3 {White keeps an extra minor piece and
Black is in trouble. Try again and look for a stronger capture.}) 8. d4 {
Good choice! What must Black play next to keep good winning chances?} bxc3 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try again and look for a strong capture.] 
[%hint Capture an undefended piece.] Well done! White's big center offers some
compensation for Black's two extra pawns, but the engines still prefer Black's
material edge.} *

queen!} (10. Qxa1 $5 {This is a good move, but there's a check that's even

{How should White develop against Black's inaccurate Be6 move?} 6. Nf3 {
[%wrong There's a better option. Try to find a good way to develop with a
threat.] [%hint Develop a knight to attack a pawn.]} (6. Qb3 $2 Nb4 {Black
avoids any dangerous captures from White and attacks the white queen. Try
again and look for a stronger move to develop with a threat.}) (6. Nxd5 $2 Bxd5
{Black recaptures with great center control. Try again and look for a good
developing move.}) (6. Bxd5 $2 Bxd5 {Black recaptures with great center
control. Try again and look for a good developing move.}) (6. d4 $2 exd4 {
Black is ready to meet Qxd4 with Nc6. Try again and look for a way to develop
and control d4 with another piece.}) 6... Nc6 {Good start! How should you
continue to develop?} 7. O-O {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and
look for a way to secure your king.] [%hint Castle your king to safety.]} (7.
d4 $2 Bb4 {Black uses a pin to reach a safe position. Try again and look for a
way to prepare d4 by securing your king.}) (7. d3 $2 Be7 {Black has a safe
position. Try again and look for a way to prepare a more active d-pawn move by
securing your king.}) (7. e4 $2 Ndb4 {Black gains control of the critical d3
and d4-squares. Try again and look for a way to secure your king.}) 7... Be7 {
Nice move! How should White take over the center?} 8. d4 {[%wrong There's a
better option. Try again and look for a strong pawn break.] [%hint Trade pawns
in the center.] Great work! After a trade on d4, the g2-bishop will rip through
the Black position and White's in control.} (8. e4 $2 Ndb4 {Black gains
control of the critical d3 and d4-squares. Try again and look for a better
pawn move to fight for the center.}) *

knight.] [%hint Save your knight and target the e4-pawn.]} (6. Nh4 $5 {This is
a good choice, but it's even stronger to target the e4-pawn. How should you do
it?}) (6. Ng1 $2 Qe7 {There's a much more active knight move. Try to find a

Kf1 $2 Qxg5 {The king's a little exposed in the center. Try again and look for
a safer king move.}) (8. Ke1 $2 Qxg5 {The king's a little exposed in the
center. Try again and look for a safer king move.}) 8... Qxg5 {Nice move!
What's next?} 9. Nxe4 {[%wrong There's a better move. Try again and look for a
good capture.] [%hint Capture a pawn and attack the black queen.] Well played!
